name: dotnet-upgrade
description: Ready-to-use prompts for comprehensive .NET framework upgrade analysis and execution

Analyze all solution projects: classify as `.NET Framework`, `.NET Core`, or `.NET Standard`; inspect `.csproj` `TargetFramework` and SDK usage. Review internal/external and transitive dependency compatibility, graph depth, conflicts, outdated NuGet packages, .NET 8 support, shared dependencies, and alternatives in Microsoft-supported namespaces. Identify `packages.config` projects for `PackageReference` migration.

Recommend least-to-most-dependent upgrade order; isolate class libraries before APIs or Azure Functions. Plan incremental upgrades with rollback checkpoints; evaluate **Upgrade Assistant** versus manual upgrades. Select each project’s `TargetFramework` (e.g., `net8.0`); update deprecated SDK/build configurations. Detect modernization needs (`WebHostBuilder` → `HostBuilder`), deprecated/removed APIs and namespaces, breaking changes, and `Startup.cs` → `Program.cs`; suggest replacements and async conversions where appropriate.

Review YAML SDK pinning; recommend `UseDotNet@2` and `NuGetToolInstaller` updates. Generate .NET 8 pipeline snippets, feature-branch validation builds, CI build/test automation, and build, unit, integration, runtime, logging, telemetry, connectivity, backward-compatibility, regression, UAT, and production verification plans.

Recommend safe branching and rollback; commit templates; structured PRs (`Upgrade to .NET [Version]`), breaking-change tags, review checklists, per-project framework-change documentation, release notes, stakeholder communications, dependency/validation templates, dashboards, and markdown progress checklists.

Recommend `.NET Upgrade Assistant`, `dotnet list package --outdated`, `dotnet migrate`, and `graph.json`; generate dependency-analysis scripts and Copilot prompts. Plan standardized multi-repository validation. Confirm final builds, tests, deployment checks, results, artifacts, and release documentation summarizing framework changes and CI/CD updates.
